elements.content: Grammar focus: Extraposition of Clausal Subjects.

Core Rule: Move heavy clausal subjects to the end of the sentence and insert dummy It in subject position: It + Passive / Adjectival Predicate + That-Clause / Infinitive Clause .

That-Clause Extraposition — It is + Adj/V3 + that...: It is widely maintained that cybernetic governance requires ethical oversight.
Infinitive Extraposition — It is + Adj + to + Base: It is essential to verify raw telemetry prior to algorithmic training.
Wh-Clause Extraposition — It remains + Adj + Wh-clause: It remains unclear whether market liquidity will recover in Q4.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence correctly applies clausal subject extraposition?
options: It is generally accepted that renewable energy transition is urgent.
That renewable energy transition is urgent is generally accepted.
